title: Cone Gram determinant scaling: Γ(a, t·w) = (t^k)²·Γ(a, w) for every real t
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P), w = (w_0, …, w_{k−1}) with every w_i ∈ ℝ^P, and t ∈ ℝ (no sign condition). For a finite family v = (v_0, …, v_m) of vectors of ℝ^P let Γ(v) := det[⟨v_i, v_j⟩]_{i,j}, i.e. Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)). Write (a, u) := Fin.cons a u = (a, u_0, …, u_{k−1}) for u : Fin k → ℝ^P (a family indexed by Fin (k+1)), and t·w := (t w_0, …, t w_{k−1}). Then Γ(a, t·w) = (t^k)²·Γ(a, w).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P) (t : ℝ), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a (t • w) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)) = (t ^ k) ^ 2 * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))
